description:
InHouse Wellness is an authorized dealer for home saunas and cold plunges. We carry 10+ brands including — infrared and traditional saunas, cold plunge tubs, chillers, and the accessories that go with them.

Products run from $2500 for entry units to $50,000+ for full outdoor builds. Our average order value is $7,000+, which is the number that matters here: this is a high-ticket category where a single conversion is worth more than a month of promoting typical wellness products.

We're a real dealer with real customers, not a dropship storefront. We handle pre-sale consultation, spec questions, delivery coordination, and warranty support.

What makes us different

One link, every brand. Most programs in this space are single-manufacturer. If you write comparison content — "best cold plunges under $5K," "infrared vs traditional sauna," roundups, buyer's guides — you'd normally need separate programs for each product you mention, and you'd lose the ones that don't have a program. With us, one link monetizes the whole piece regardless of which brand your reader chooses.

Commission that reflects the price point. A single sauna or plunge sale pays 10%. You don't need volume to make this worth your time.

A 60-day cookie. Nobody buys a $5,000 sauna on first click. Typical research-to-purchase is weeks to months. Most programs run 30 days and quietly lose you the sale. We don't.

We actually close. Our team fields the technical questions — electrical requirements, pad and foundation, chiller sizing, install — that kill conversions on self-serve sites. Your traffic converts at a higher rate because there's a human on the other end.

How affiliates can earn

  • Saunas and cold plunges: 10% per sale
  • Cookie window: 60 days, last-click
  • Payout: Bi-Monthly
  • Validation: commissions approve after the 60-day return window
  • Performance rates available. Drive consistent volume and we'll raise your rate. Just ask — we do custom rates for partners producing results, and for publishers with relevant audience we'll discuss a bump before you've sent a single click.

How to promote us

What works in this category, in rough order of performance:

  • Comparison and roundup content. "Best cold plunge tubs," "best home saunas under $X," brand-vs-brand comparisons. This outperforms single-product reviews by a wide margin here, because buyers at this price point comparison-shop hard.
  • Buyer's guides that answer cost questions. Total installed cost, electrical and permitting requirements, chiller vs ice, indoor vs outdoor, maintenance and running costs. These rank well and attract people who are already close to buying.
  • Recovery and training content. Cold exposure protocols, sauna and heat adaptation, post-workout recovery routines. Natural fit for a product link.
  • Home gym and outdoor living builds. Garage gym tours, backyard and patio projects, home renovation and spa-room content.
  • YouTube. Install walkthroughs, first impressions, six-month follow-ups. Long-form video converts unusually well on high-ticket.
  • Email. If you have a fitness, biohacking, recovery, or home improvement list, a single well-placed feature can cover a quarter.

Good fits: recovery and fitness sites, home gym and garage gym channels, biohacking and longevity creators, home improvement and outdoor living blogs, personal trainers, chiropractors, physical therapists, gym and recovery studio owners, and anyone whose audience is already spending on wellness equipment.

We provide product images, spec sheets, a product feed, and comparison data across brands. If you need something specific for a piece you're writing, ask and we'll put it together.

Other information

  • Approval: [auto-approve for sites and channels in relevant categories / manual review within 48 hours]. Tell us how you plan to promote and we'll get you set up quickly.
  • MAP compliance required. Because we're an authorized dealer, manufacturer minimum advertised pricing applies. Don't advertise prices below what's listed on our site, and don't create discount or coupon codes we haven't issued.
  • No branded PPC. Don't bid on our brand name or our manufacturers' brand names in paid search.
  • Not permitted: coupon and deal sites, cashback extensions, trademark bidding, unauthorized use of manufacturer logos, or claims about health outcomes we haven't made ourselves.
  • Questions or custom requests: Support@InHouseWellness.com. We answer.
term_and_condition:
Welcome to Inhousewellness! Thanks for joining our Affiliate program.

These following terms and conditions apply to individuals who are accessing or using the Program both as a merchant (“we” or “merchant”) and an affiliate (“you” or “affiliate”) who refers customers to use product or service from the merchant.

By participating in the Program, Affiliate agrees to use the Program in the manner specified in, and are bound by, these Terms and Conditions. If you do not agree to these Terms and Conditions in their entirety you are not authorized to register as an Affiliate or participate in the Program in any manner.


1. Approve or Reject of the Registration

We reserve the right to approve or reject ANY Affiliate Program Registration in our sole and absolute discretion. You will have no legal recourse against us for the rejection of your Affiliate Program Registration.


2. Affiliate Links and Coupon

Affiliate link is automatically generated, but you can also generate an affiliate link for a specific product or collection. If a person clicks on someone else’s referral link and then later they click on yours, yours is the one that counts.

Affiliate might or might not be assigned to one coupon code with details and usage clarified on Dashboard. If customer both click on the affiliate link and use coupon code, you will not receive a double commission. If you’re not assigned a branded coupon, then you’re not allowed to promote the coupon.

Affiliate may also advertise merchant website on online channels such as Facebook, Instagram,... or offline classified channel ads, magazines, and newspapers.


3. Commissions and payment

Refer any customer to make a purchase on our website, you will get a commission amount which is calculated based on Commission structure. Commission amount is dependent on order value and not including extra fee (tax, shipping cost,...).

For an Affiliate to receive a commission, you need to specify the payment details on Settings. Payment schedule will be notified on Affiliate Guide page.

Payments will only be sent for transactions that have been successfully completed. Use of the Affiliate Program is subject to a fair use policy which gives merchant the right to review each and every referral order. Status of commission if displayed in Commission tab, any paid commission will be listed on Payment tab. Transactions that result in charge backs or refunds will not be paid out.


4. Marketing tool

We may share promotion media such as banner, logo or specific collection promotion to you through Marketing tool tab. You can download the media or get the HTML embed code in order to share on affiliate channels.


5. Network

If Network tab is activated, affiliate can invite others to become their downline affiliate. If any downline affiliate brings order to merchant shop, upline affiliate will also get network commission which depends on merchant settings.

To invite other affiliates into the system, share network link and any other affiliate who click on that link and sign up will become a downline affiliate.


6. Cookie

We use a cookie to track people who have clicked on your link, so they need to be using cookies for us to track them.

If a person doesn't allow cookies or clears their cookies then we can't track them so can't pay earnings on that person's activity.

Cookies day is said on the Affiliate registration form. The tracking day will start from the time a customer clicks on the affiliate’s link or use the coupon. Within the cookie time, every order made by this customer at merchant website will automatically result in commissions to the affiliate (There’s no need for the customer to click on the affiliate link then).


7. Removal from Referral Program

If an affiliate wishes to be removed from the affiliate program, they can do so by contacting: julian@inhousewellness.com.


Go forward and refer!

We're very glad you've made it to the end of this important document.

We wish you all the very best. You can always re-visit these Affiliate Program terms and conditions in the future and if you have any questions you can send email to julian@inhousewellness.com for support.
